_comment: Hostnames and whether the SSRF guard must refuse them. Mirrors isBlockedTarget in web/api/feed.js and web/api/article.js. Consumed by apple/tests/host-guard.test.mjs (against those functions) and by NoozCoreTests (against HostGuard.swift). Known gap shared by all three: hostnames that only RESOLVE to an internal address (DNS rebinding) are not detected.

cases.note: SHARED QUIRK: the reference guard's startsWith('fc') also refuses hostnames beginning fc/fd. Kept identical on purpose so the native shell and the web proxy never disagree; fixing it is a web/ change (owner).
